thread:
noah (docs): Heads up — the API ref for the /v1/streams/upload-progress endpoint currently lists a 200 response in examples, but the runtime returns 206 Partial Content for chunked progress updates. This is causing confusion in devs and our SDK tests.

tara (eng-runtime): ah yeah, we switched to 206 during the streaming overhaul so we could signal resumable ranges. docs must be updated. thanks for catching.

noah (docs): I put together a quick PR draft but want to confirm the full response shape before pushing. Current doc example shows: 
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "uploaded_bytes": 12345
}
```
But runtime actually emits a wrapper with chunk metadata: 
```json
{
  "chunk_index": 3,
  "chunk_size": 65536,
  "uploaded_bytes": 262144,
  "complete": false
}
```
Should we include both a 206 example and a final 200/201 completion example?

tara (eng-runtime): yes — stream progress events are 206 until finalization. Final manifest response is 201 with full file metadata. So docs should show:
- 206 SSE / chunk examples (short)
- final 201 JSON example for completion

ben (sdk): SDK streaming helper currently assumes 200 to detect streaming vs single response. I'll update the Node/Python snippets to check for 206 as streaming. I'll push a tiny patch.

maya (pm): can we also add a note mentioning that proxies might coalesce chunked SSE and to prefer the SDK helpers? We got a support ticket where nginx buffered the stream.

noah (docs): good call. I'll add a short note under "Streaming caveats" about proxies and recommend SDK helpers. Draft change list:
1) Update HTTP status in examples to 206 for progress chunk events.
2) Add final 201 example with full file metadata.
3) Update Node/Python snippets to treat 206 as streaming.
4) Add proxy buffering caveat and link to troubleshooting section.

ci-bot: build/test status: docs-pr/1748881230-update-streaming-status — tests (docs lint + sdk smoke) queued.

ben (sdk): pushed sdk patch in a branch, updated JS helper:
```js
// treat 206 as streaming start
if (res.status === 206 || res.headers['content-type'] === 'text/event-stream') {
  // stream handler
}
```

tara (eng-runtime): thanks — once docs PR is ready I'll add a note in the changelog (runtime: streaming status code change). Also confirm final response is 201 not 200.

noah (docs): PR submitted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4892 — includes examples and caveat blurb. leaving it for review.

maya (pm): LGTM from product POV. small wording nit in the caveat but non-blocking.

noah (docs): thanks all. I'll merge once doc lint and smoke tests pass. Will add a one-line note to migration guide for teams that parse status codes in custom infra.
